properties.summary: The finished Phase I building (The Launch) uses its real footprint and the height in its approved design. Phase II's townhome lots and Phase III's lot (The Foundry) are illustrative: whole lots drawn to the master plan's 45-ft and 65-ft limits, not building designs. Building 19 and the other maritime commercial buildings, the marina, parks and streets aren't drawn.
properties.note: Unbuilt phases are drawn as lots at their height limits, not as building designs.
properties.sourceLabel: Alameda Marina master plan staff report, 2018
properties.georeference: Footprint and parcels as published (OpenStreetMap via Overture; Alameda County Assessor parcels).
properties.license: Building footprint: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL 1.0), via Overture Maps. Parcels: Alameda County open data (county disclaimer).

properties.label: The Launch
properties.source: footprint: OpenStreetMap r16011797 ("The Launch Apartments") via Overture 2026-09-23.1; height: "varies between approximately 50' to 60' in height", Planning Board staff report, Phase I (Wrap A) design review (Oct 14, 2019) (https://webapi.legistar.com/v1/alameda/matters/9050/texts/9650); complete per City Council staff report, Phase III affordable housing amendment (June 1, 2026) (https://webapi.legistar.com/v1/alameda/matters/15877/texts/17084)
properties.note: A four- to five-story building, 50–60 ft, around a parking garage; drawn at 60 ft.

properties.label: Phase II townhomes
properties.source: illustrative: the Tract 8610 lots (Alameda County Assessor parcels 71-292 and 71-293, https://services5.arcgis.com/ROBnTHSNjoZ2Wm1P/arcgis/rest/services/Parcels/FeatureServer/0) drawn to the master plan's 45-ft limit for the balance of the site, Planning Board staff report, Alameda Marina Master Plan (May 2018) (https://webapi.legistar.com/v1/alameda/matters/7315/texts/7770); under construction per City Council staff report, Phase III affordable housing amendment (June 1, 2026)
properties.note: 182 townhomes in 31 buildings, drawn as their lots at the 45-ft limit. 11 of the buildings are already mapped in OpenStreetMap.

properties.label: The Foundry (Wrap B)
properties.use: Residential (259 rental homes and a work/live unit)
properties.source: illustrative: Lot 4 of Tract 8500 (Tract 8711 "The Foundry"; Alameda County Assessor parcel 71-291-12) drawn to the building's 65-ft maximum, "varies in height between 50 and 65 feet", Planning Board staff report, Phase III (Wrap B) design review (July 10, 2023) (https://webapi.legistar.com/v1/alameda/matters/13013/texts/13902)
properties.note: Approved in 2023 with 259 homes; in July 2026 the City cut its affordable homes from 43 to 21 (Ordinance 3406) and the applicant said construction could start that summer.
